assets.title: Ocean House with Full Interior
assets.creator: ooKrazy8oo

schematic.blockEntityPolicy: Import block states only. Do not transfer third-party block entity NBT; leave storage and signs empty unless reviewed.

assets.visualAssessment: Grey deep-eave roof, timber upper facade, furnished balcony, water-level stilts and short pier. Preview actually inspected.
assets.recommendedUse: Lakeside visitor service hut or small pier building; place at a shoreline with a 29x14 footprint and preserve a few blocks in front for the pier. Adapt materials and signs to the 1993 park.

assets.title: Fisherman House
assets.creator: Heldorya Studio

schematic.blockEntityPolicy: Import block states only. Signs are blank and containers empty; omit all 11 source entities and 107 source block entity NBT records.

assets.visualAssessment: Blue-green waterfront house, timber roof, elevated deck and broad waterside steps. Source preview actually inspected.
assets.recommendedUse: Installed on the central park lake west shore, distinct from Ocean House; the lake and existing path are preserved.

assets.title: JPOG Visitor Center Entrance JP
assets.creator: Planet Minecraft uploader (verify source page credit)

schematic.blockEntityPolicy: Never import source entities or tile entity NBT; source includes hostile mobs and old door/sign data.

assets.visualAssessment: Source is a large elliptical structure with a broad terrain base; inspected offline as schematic layers, not in game.
assets.recommendedUse: Trimmed architecture replaces the existing visitor center, with the south entrance path preserved and the old outer eaves cleared.

assets.title: Mediterranean Style Home
assets.creator: TheMythicalSausage

schematic.containerPolicy: Source has zero block entity NBT records. Nineteen container-like block states are imported without contents and remain empty.

assets.visualAssessment: Yellow walls, stepped red-tile roof, tower, vines and deep-set windows. Preview actually inspected.
assets.recommendedUse: Tropical city street house or visitor district building; reserve a 26x27 footprint and adapt the facade to the 1993 park setting.
